thesis: The site is the valley's garden almanac: each section is a season of the Modesto year, and the almanac ribbon tracks where you are in it.

signature.name: valley-almanac-ribbon
signature.summary: Horizontal twelve-month strip at the top of every section; current month marked with accent dot, active season band shaded beneath. Marker advances on scroll via --sw-p; color field cross-fades to season tint. Reused in hero, services, proof, tools, contact and footer.

motion.intro: Soft fog layer lifts off mosaic (opacity+blur ease-out, 900ms); almanac ribbon fades in from left.
stories: Almanac ribbon marker advances month-by-month on scroll; section tint cross-fades to season color.
Mature-size silhouette grows from sapling to canopy in shade trees section via clip-path.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX on links and buttons.
